name: Counterfeit SNT: A Public Health Crisis in the Lower Tiers
author: GLMZ Health Authority, Division of Augmentation Safety
body:
Counterfeit Synthetic Neurovascular Tissue is killing people in the GLMZ. This report documents the scope of the crisis and the systemic failures that enable it.

The economics are simple. Genuine Gen 7 SNT costs approximately Φ2,400 per square centimeter at wholesale. A standard cybernetic arm requires 180 cm² of SNT, costing Φ432,000 for the bonding material alone — before the cost of the implant itself, surgery, and recovery. For a Tier 1 resident earning Φ120/month in UBC, this is 300 years of income.

Black-market SNT costs Φ200-600 per cm². It is affordable. It is also, in approximately 15% of cases, not genuine SNT.

COUNTERFEIT CATEGORIES:

TYPE 1 — RELABELED OBSOLETE (40% of counterfeits): Genuine SNT of Generation 3-5, relabeled as Gen 7. Functionally inferior but often viable. Rejection rate: 4-8% (vs. 0.6% for genuine Gen 7). Source: diverted hospital surplus, expired stockpiles, recycled from cadavers.

TYPE 2 — DILUTED GENUINE (25%): Gen 7 SNT sheets stretched by mixing with inert biocompatible scaffold. Partially functional. Reduced integration strength leads to implant migration and chronic pain. Rejection rate: 6-10%.

TYPE 3 — SYNTHETIC SUBSTITUTE (20%): Laboratory-grown tissue cultures that superficially resemble SNT but lack neural bridging capability. The implant bonds mechanically but has no nerve integration — the patient gets a prosthetic that they cannot feel or control through neural signals. Some patients do not discover this for weeks.

TYPE 4 — COMPLETE FRAUD (15%): Material with no biological activity. Protein film, collagen sheets, or industrial sealant packaged in counterfeit sterile wrapping. Rejection rate: 100%. Mortality rate without emergency intervention: 40%.

In the past year, GLMZ hospitals treated 2,847 patients for SNT rejection events. Of these, 1,940 (68%) involved counterfeit or substandard material. 147 patients died. The majority were Tier 1-2 residents who could not afford legitimate augmentation.

The counterfeit SNT supply chain is robust, decentralized, and protected by jurisdictional fragmentation. A counterfeiter operating in one corponation's territory sells to a distributor in another, who supplies a ripper in a third. No single jurisdiction has the authority or incentive to dismantle the entire chain.
